title: Connected Data in Reports and Pipelines: Live, Imported and Permissions | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Connected data sets appear next to your site's own data wherever you pick a data source. See a live and an imported data set used in the Report Builder and in a data pipeline, and the permissions that decide who can read each one.

In this video:
• Where connected data sets appear: Connected data (live) and Connected data (imported)
• Building a report on a live data set, and what an imported data set's card shows
• The Read a data source step of a data pipeline
• Read every connected data set, or Read the connected data set for one data set, in Access Control > Roles
• One rule for live and imported data

chapters.title: Who can read a data set
